audience: Brazilian companies that send contracts for e-signature with ZapAssina

useCases.title: Send a contract from a template
useCases.text: Read the fields of a template, then create a signing document with the field values. The invitation is not emailed unless you ask for it.

useCases.title: Check which signers still have to sign
useCases.text: Search and filter documents, then open one to see each signer's status and signing link. File links expire after 60 minutes.

useCases.title: Send a ready PDF for signature
useCases.text: Send a PDF for signature by file or URL, up to 25 MB. Signature positions follow the signer anchors written in the PDF text.

useCases.title: Organize documents in folders
useCases.text: Create a folder, then move a document into it. Missing folders are created for you.

useCases.title: Adjust signers and the signing deadline
useCases.text: Add a signer, update one who has not signed yet, or set a new signing deadline. A new deadline reopens an expired document.
